title: Kettlebell Clean
summary: A swing that finishes with the bell in the rack position at your shoulder. It's a power and technique lift and builds little muscle.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.6 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.5 for hamstrings (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.
Library rating 0.4 for traps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.4 for forearms (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Hike the bell back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell close to your body.
Let it land softly in the rack with your wrist straight.

form_cues.cue: Drive the hips and pull the elbow close
Rotate the bell softly into the rack
Keep it close so it doesn't flip onto your forearm.

mistakes.text: Letting the bell flip over and bang the forearm.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
